olivia_sales: Hey team — on the ACME POC they flagged the SIG/CAIQ access control section. They want explicit evidence for SSO/SAML, MFA enforcement, RBAC/least-privilege mappings, SCIM provisioning, and audit log retention. Need to send by EOD PDT. Can we assemble a short answer + artifacts? CC @maria_security @kevin_devops

maria_security: We can. Short answers first: SAML 2.0 supported (IdP- & SP-initiated), SCIM 2.0 for provisioning, MFA required for all interactive user logins, RBAC with default roles (admin/engineer/auditor/readonly) + custom roles supported. Audit logs retained 365 days. I'll prepare a one-page evidence pack and redacted SAML metadata. :white_check_mark:

kevin_devops: I can pull artifacts. Plan: 1) redacted SAML metadata XML 2) screenshot of org auth policy in console 3) SCIM sample payload (JSON) 4) audit export CSV (last 30 days). Command I used to export audits: `rctl audit export --start 2024-06-01 --end 2024-06-30 --filter auth,user --format csv` — will run with customer dates. ETA ~2h.

olivia_sales: Great. Also need canonical text snippets we can paste into the CAIQ answers (very short, declarative). Eg one-liners for SAML, MFA, RBAC, SCIM, audit retention.

maria_security: Draft snippets I'll attach: "SAML/OIDC: We support SAML 2.0 (IdP and SP initiated). Customers may supply IdP metadata or use our metadata endpoint."; "MFA: MFA is enforced for all interactive user authentications. Exceptions are not permitted by org policy and are logged."; "RBAC: We provide built-in roles (admin, engineer, auditor, readonly) and support custom role definitions to enforce least privilege; role grants are audited."; "SCIM: SCIM 2.0 supported for automated user provisioning and deprovisioning."; "Audit: Authentication and admin activity logs are retained 365 days and available for export."

kevin_devops: One note for the customer: service-to-service credentials are scoped, rotated, and limited via token TTLs. For API key creation we require an MFA confirmation step in the console and keys can be scoped to resources. I can generate a sample policies.csv mapping roles->permissions for their security team.

olivia_sales: Perfect — once you both upload the artifacts I'll paste the one-paragraph answers into the CAIQ. I'll also include the redacted SAML metadata and the audit export. Thanks! :pray:

maria_security: Uploaded evidence pack to the deal folder (link pasted in DM). If ACME requests signed metadata or a PKI artifact let me know; we can coordinate with legal for LOA.

kevin_devops: Artifacts are in the same folder: `saml-metadata.xml` (redacted), `scim-sample.json`, `audit-export-30d.csv`, `rbac-mapping.csv`. Ping if they want raw logs or a signed statement.

olivia_sales: Sending now. Will update the thread if they come back with follow-ups.
__notes: Slack thread style: short messages, @mentions, inline code. No title field per agents.md.
